closing.summary: Big strengths are whole-food carb package, works across a lot of cooking styles, and practical staple carb source, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low vitamin A, and low protein quality. It is good for practical meals and immune support because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around and vitamin C gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
